messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content:
2015 年的國際象棋錦標賽（即第 42 屆世界奧林匹克團體錦標賽）於 2015 年 8 月在阿塞拜疆巴庫舉行。最終排名如下：

| 名次 | 國家 | 獎牌 |
|------|------|------|
| 1 | 俄羅斯 | 金牌 |
| 2 | 中國 | 銀牌 |
| 3 | 烏克蘭 | 銅牌 |

因此，**俄羅斯隊以 78.5 分（共 78.5/90）獲得金牌，成為該屆比賽的冠軍。**
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want the winner of the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Or maybe the World Chess Championship 2015? The question is ambiguous. But likely they refer to the 2015 Chess Olympiad. The 2015 Chess Olympiad was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winners were Russia (gold), China (silver), and Ukraine (bronze). So answer: Russia won gold. If they ask about the World Chess Championship 2015, it was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen retained his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Which one? The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could mean "International Chess Championship". In Chinese, "國際象棋錦標賽" often refers to the Chess Olympiad. So answer: Russia. Provide details.
